title: South Cotabato school shooter's dad relieved from DepEd post pending probe
summary: The father of the student, who opened fire at the Banga National High School in South Cotabato province last week, has been relieved from his post as Disaster Risk Mitigation Officer of the…

blocks.text: The father of the student, who opened fire at the Banga National High School in South Cotabato province last week, has been relieved from his post as Disaster Risk Mitigation Officer of the Department of Education, pending police investigation.
